meta.methodology: Question design draws from conversational persona-based prompts (Zhang et al., 2018, Persona-Chat, ACL) and structured free-writing elicitation protocols (Pennebaker et al., LIWC). Questions are intentionally open-ended to elicit naturalistic, multi-clause descriptive sentences.

questions.text: Describe your favorite animal and explain what makes it special to you.
What does your favorite animal usually eat and how does it find its food?
Describe the place where your favorite animal lives in the wild.
How does your favorite animal behave when it feels happy or excited?
What sounds does your favorite animal make and when does it make them?
Describe what your favorite animal looks like including its size and color.
How does your favorite animal protect itself from danger?
Explain how your favorite animal sleeps and where it rests at night.
What would a typical day look like for your favorite animal in the wild?
Describe how your favorite animal interacts with other animals around it.
If you could have any animal as a pet, what would it be and why?
Describe the personality traits you think your favorite animal has.
How does your favorite animal move around and travel from place to place?
What happens to your favorite animal when the weather changes with the seasons?
Describe a time you saw an interesting animal and what it was doing.
How do baby versions of your favorite animal behave differently from adults?
What is the most fascinating fact you know about any animal and why does it interest you?
Describe how your favorite animal communicates with other members of its group.
What kind of environment or habitat would you build if you could design one for your favorite animal?
Explain why some people are afraid of certain animals and whether you agree with them.
Describe what your favorite animal does when it feels threatened or scared.
How does your favorite animal take care of its young ones after they are born?
What role does your favorite animal play in the natural ecosystem it belongs to?
Describe an animal you recently learned about and what surprised you most.
How would you explain your favorite animal to someone who has never seen one before?
What do you think your favorite animal dreams about when it falls asleep?
Describe the differences between a wild version and a domesticated version of an animal you know.
How does your favorite animal respond to human beings who approach it?
Explain what makes certain animals good companions for people and describe an example.
Describe the most beautiful animal you have ever seen and what made it beautiful.
What challenges does your favorite animal face in the modern world today?
Describe how different animals adapt to living in extremely cold or hot environments.
How do you think animals experience emotions compared to the way humans do?
Describe a scene from nature that involves multiple animals interacting together.
What would you name a new species of animal if you discovered one and what would it look like?
Describe how your favorite animal hunts for food or gathers things it needs to survive.
How does the relationship between humans and animals change as cities grow larger?
Describe an animal that lives in water and explain how it survives beneath the surface.
What lessons do you think humans can learn from observing how animals live their lives?
Describe a memorable encounter you had with an animal and how it made you feel.
Describe what you usually do during the first hour after you wake up each morning.
What does your ideal breakfast look like and how do you prepare it?
Describe your journey from home to work or school including what you see along the way.
How do you decide what clothes to wear each day and what influences your choice?
Describe the place where you spend most of your time during the day.
What do you typically eat for lunch and where do you usually have it?
Describe your evening routine from the moment you finish your main responsibilities.
How do you usually relax after a long and tiring day?
Describe the sounds you hear around your home at different times of the day.
What is your favorite meal to cook at home and how do you make it step by step?
Describe how your daily routine changes when the weather is rainy compared to sunny.
How do you organize your tasks and decide which things to do first each day?
Describe what your neighborhood looks like when you step outside in the morning.
What do you usually drink throughout the day and when do you drink it?
Describe a typical weekend day from start to finish and how it differs from weekdays.
How do you prepare yourself to go to sleep at night and what helps you fall asleep?
Describe the most productive part of your day and explain why you feel most focused then.
What do you usually do while eating your meals and who do you eat with?
Describe how your morning routine has changed compared to what it was a few years ago.
How do you spend your time when you are waiting for something or someone?
Describe the things you always carry with you when you leave your home.
What is the first thing you usually check or look at when you start your day?
Describe a regular chore you do at home and how you go about completing it.
How does your routine change when you have guests visiting your home?
Describe the view from the window closest to where you usually sit during the day.
What music or sounds do you like to listen to during different parts of your day?
Describe what happens in your household when everyone is getting ready at the same time.
How do you handle unexpected changes or interruptions to your daily schedule?
Describe the one part of your daily routine that you enjoy the most and look forward to.
What is something you do every single day without fail and why is it important to you?
Describe how you usually spend the last thirty minutes before going to bed.
How does your daily routine change during holidays or special occasions?
Describe the tools or devices you use most frequently throughout a typical day.
What snacks do you enjoy eating between meals and when do you usually have them?
Describe your perfect lazy day and all the things you would do from morning to night.
Describe your favorite hobby and explain why you started doing it in the first place.
What materials or tools do you need for your favorite hobby and how do you use them?
Describe the process of creating something you are proud of from start to finish.
How did you first learn the skill that your favorite hobby requires?
Describe a recent project or activity related to your hobby and what you accomplished.
What is the most challenging part of your favorite hobby and how do you overcome it?
Describe how your hobby makes you feel when you are fully engaged in it.
How has your skill level in your favorite hobby improved since you first started?
Describe the space or environment where you usually practice your hobby.
What advice would you give to someone who wants to start learning your hobby today?
Describe a creative project you would love to work on if you had unlimited time and resources.
How do you find inspiration or new ideas for things to create or practice?
Describe the difference between doing your hobby alone versus doing it with other people.
What is the most useful skill you have ever taught yourself and how did you learn it?
Describe a mistake you made while practicing your hobby and what you learned from it.
How do you balance spending time on your hobby with your other daily responsibilities?
Describe a book or movie or song that inspired you to try something new and creative.
What would you create if you had to make a gift for someone using only your hobby skills?
Describe how technology has changed the way people practice your favorite hobby.
How do you stay motivated to keep practicing your hobby when progress feels slow?
Describe the feeling of finishing a difficult project and showing it to someone for the first time.
What new hobby or skill would you love to learn next and what attracts you to it?
Describe how your favorite hobby connects you with other people who share the same interest.
How do you decide when a creative project is finished and ready to be shared?
Describe the evolution of your hobby from when you first started to where you are now.
What is the most surprising thing you have discovered through practicing your hobby?
Describe how you would teach your favorite hobby to a young child step by step.
How does practicing your hobby help you deal with stress or difficult emotions?
Describe a time when your hobby led you to an unexpected experience or opportunity.
What part of your hobby do you wish more people understood or appreciated?
Describe the sounds and sensations you experience while actively engaged in your hobby.
How would your life be different if you had never discovered your favorite hobby?
Describe a goal you have set for yourself related to your hobby and your plan to achieve it.
What resources or communities have helped you improve at your hobby the most?
Describe what a perfect session of your favorite hobby looks like from beginning to end.
